headline: Why have I kept this connection alive on my own?
note: Wired 2026-08-25 from fb-tarot/docs/writeups/shadow/REVIEW-money-alone-commit-2026-08-25.md — approved copy, transferred verbatim. Reuses the existing LONELINESS_TAROT_HOOKS frame; no new guard.

a: You turned the Magician. You couldn't see the cards, but your hand found the worker of the three.
Both hands are busy above a table full of tools.
You asked why you kept this connection alive on your own. The two working hands hold my attention.
The connection remained alive through your effort, and the other side did not carry it with you.
Something appears just where shared effort should begin. I don't think it started with you.
Let me look closer at what has hold of this…
b: You turned the Hanged Man. The backs gave no clue, yet you chose the one held by a single thing.
One rope holds the figure at one ankle.
You said the connection depended on you. This card makes me look at the one point carrying the suspension.
Still, the connection was held open by one side, according to the question you brought.
There's something between the connection and equal weight. I don't think it began with you.
Let me see what's holding the connection…
c: You turned the Fool. Nothing revealed the picture, but your hand went to the one carrying the whole load he has.
One small bundle rests on the stick over his shoulder.
You asked why you carried the connection alone. The single bundle is the part I cannot ignore.
But you were the one carrying it, and the connection did not move on its own.
What has hold of the bond leaves the carrying on one side. I don't think this began with you.
Now let me look at what has hold of the bond…
